value.rationale: The exact expectation quantifies random-order fill on every tree and proves the unique path-to-star transition from linear-scale to quadratic-scale fill, despite all trees allowing no-fill leaf orderings. The path law provides a full-distribution and Gaussian-fluctuation benchmark; the natural data structure and storage cost precede rather than depend on a heuristic special case.
